description: This PHP source file defines the class GetUserPreferencesParams within the Api\V8\Param namespace. It extends a base parameter class, includes a method to retrieve a user ID parameter, and configures parameter options. It is part of an API module for handling user preferences in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

classes.name: GetUserPreferencesParams
classes.description: Class representing parameters for retrieving user preferences, allowing access to user ID and configuring parameters via options resolver.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID parameter from the parameters array.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the options resolver with specific parameter options, particularly the ID.
